rationale: Positives: The agent properly verified the user by full name and zip, then accessed only that user’s orders. It provided the tablet storage detail from the order. Negatives: 1) The agent performed a profile-changing write (updated default shipping address) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any write. 2) The agent stated order statuses (one cancelled/refunded, the other delivered) and provided a tracking number without clear evidence from the shown tool outputs; these may be correct if present in truncated data, but from what’s visible they’re not clearly supported. 3) When asked to check if the package was still in transit, the agent did not verify via tools and instead directed the user to the carrier, despite having earlier asserted the order was delivered. The lack of explicit confirmation before the address update is a clear policy violation, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
